localChanges: A Trireme exploring on its own that ends up away from the coast with its last move now heads back to the coast for the turn and carries on exploring, instead of stopping and waiting for orders.

log: exploreLand and exploreSea move here from simple-ai-client's assignMission, and the exploring terms of its move score are exported one by one (moveGate, goodyHutTerm, discoverableTilesTerm, headingForTargetTerm, revisitTerm, over a moveContext that asks for the unit's actions once), so simple-ai-client's scoreUnitMove adds them in the same order with identical results.

Explore is an OrderStrategy for auto-explore (civ-clone/web-renderer#198). handles() is false for every action, so the computer players' play is unchanged. order() surveys once a turn, pursues the exploring missions, follows the path with followPath, then takes the best step by the exploring terms alone, re-pursuing up to PATH_TRIES times, and hands the unit back when there's nothing left, an enemy is near, or its path is blocked twice.

fix: an exploring unit only weighs steps it could come back from, and one that can't end its turn where it is (a Trireme off the coast with its last move) steps back to safety rather than being handed back
